meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 可在群组层面把智能体后端切换为 OpenAI 的 Codex，与 Claude 并行或替代。Codex 以子进程方式运行，支持流式输出、MCP 工具、服务端会话历史与恢复。凭证只存于保险库，不落盘。
howto.when: 当你在某群组上把 provider 设为 codex 并重启后，该群组的请求由 Codex 处理；默认新群组仍是 Claude，需显式切换。

say.text: 把群组 my-group 的 provider 改为 codex，并重启它。
say.note: 该群组将改用 Codex 处理对话。

say.text: 运行 add-codex 安装流程，并按提示完成认证。
say.note: 安装后还需为群组切换 provider 才会生效。

say.text: 将新群组默认 agent 设为 codex。
say.note: 只影响之后创建的群组。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw can use OpenAI's Codex as a full agent provider per group, alongside or instead of Claude. Codex runs as a child process with streaming, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume. Credentials stay vault-only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set a group's provider to codex via `ncl groups config update --id <group-id> --provider codex` and restart it. Default for new groups remains claude unless explicitly changed.

say_en.text: Switch group my-group to codex provider and restart it.
say_en.note: That group will be handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Run the add-codex installation flow and complete authentication.
say_en.note: You still need to switch a group to codex to use it.

say_en.text: Set the default agent provider to codex for new groups.
